data.title: Be the Guiding Star
data.message: Your knowledge, time, and empathy can change a child's destiny. Partner with The VIDYA School to mentor, teach, and inspire our students.

data.text: The VIDYA School invites volunteers, educators, and corporate partners to engage with our students through mentorship, workshops, cultural celebrations, and skill-building programs.

items.title: VIDYA MITR Program
items.description: A structured buddying program pairing mentors with students to build confidence, career goals, and communication skills.

items.title: Beyond Curriculum Learning
items.description: Conduct sessions demystifying Science wonders, Mathematics tricks, Cybersecurity, and English conversational fluency.

items.title: Corporate Office Inductions
items.description: Host a 2-3 hour workplace visit where professionals show students modern office workflows and career horizons.

items.title: Festival Celebrations
items.description: Light Diyas together at Diwali, sing carols at Christmas, and unfurl the tricolor on Independence Day with our students.

items.title: Friendly Sports Matches
items.description: Play a football or cricket match against our students or conduct coaching clinics on school sports day.

items.title: Workshops & Storytelling
items.description: Conduct week-long music, dance, or theater workshops, or narrate inspirational stories in the classroom.

data.text: The MITR program is a mentoring/buddying program that endeavors to use the knowledge and experience of mentors to bring out the true potential of VIDYA students.
